h: וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ אֵלָ֜יו יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיֹּאמֶר֮ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִי֒
t: וּקְרֵב לְוָתֵיהּ יְהוּדָה וַאֲמַר בְּבָעוּ רִבּוֹנִי
e: Yehudah approached him [Yoseif] and said, Please my master,
let your servant speak [now] a word in my master’s ears [before my master],
and do not be angry with your servant;
for you are equal to Pharaoh.
My master asked his servants, saying,
Do you have a father or brother?

h: וְאָחִ֨יו מֵ֜ת וַיִּוָּתֵ֨ר ה֧וּא לְבַדּ֛וֹ לְאִמּ֖וֹ וְאָבִ֥יו אֲהֵבֽוֹ׃
t: וְאָחוּהִי מִית וְאִשְׁתָּאַר הוּא בִּלְחוֹדוֹהִי לְאִמֵּהּ וַאֲבוּהִי רְחִים לֵהּ:
e: We said to my master,
We have a father who is old,
and a young child of his old age.
His brother is dead, and he alone survives of his mother, and his father loves him.
You said to your servants,
Bring him down to me,
that I may set my eyes on him.

t: לָא יִכּוּל עוּלֵימָא לְמִשְׁבַּק יָת אֲבוּהִי
e: We said to my master,
the lad cannot leave his father,
for if he left his father, he would die.

t: אִם לָא יֵחוֹת אֲחוּכוֹן זְעֵירָא עִמְּכוֹן
e: You [then] said to your servants,
If your youngest brother does not come down with you,
you shall not see my face again.
When we went
to your servant, my father,
we told him of my master’s words.
Our father said,
Go back and buy us a little food [grain].

t: אִם אִית אָחוּנָא זְעֵירָא עִמָּנָא וְנֵחוֹת
אֲרֵי לָא נִכּוּל לְמֶחֱזֵי אַפֵּי גַבְרָא
e: We said, We cannot go down.
If our youngest brother is with us, we will go down,
for we cannot see the man’s face,
unless our youngest brother is with us.
Your servant, my father said to us,
You know
that my wife [Rochel] bore me two sons.
One has [already] left me,
and I said, surely he is torn to pieces [dead].
I have not see him until now.

h: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֧ם גַּם־אֶת־זֶ֛ה מֵעִ֥ם פָּנַ֖י וְקָרָ֣הוּ אָס֑וֹן
t: וְתַדְבְּרוּן אַף יָת דֵּין מִן קֳדָמַי וִיעַרְעִנֵּיהּ מוֹתָא
e: If you take this one also away from me, and misfortune [death] befall him,
you will bring my white head down to the grave in evil.
And now, when I come to your servant, my father,
and the lad is not with us;
his soul is bound up with the lad’s [as beloved to him as his own] soul.

h: וְהוֹרִ֨ידוּ עֲבָדֶ֜יךָ אֶת־שֵׂיבַ֨ת עַבְדְּךָ֥ אָבִ֛ינוּ בְּיָג֖וֹן שְׁאֹֽלָה׃
t: וִיהֵי כַּד יֶחֱזֵי אֲרֵי לֵית עוּלֵימָא וּמִית
וְיַחֲתוּן עַבְדָיךְ יָת שִׂיבַת עַבְדָךְ אָבוּנָא בְּדָווֹנָא לִשְׁאוֹל:
e: When he sees that the lad is not [with us], he will die.
Your servants will have brought down the white head of your servant, our father, to the grave in sorrow.
For your servant became surety for the lad,
to my father, saying,
If I do not bring him to you,
I will have sinned [be a sinner] to my father for all time.

h: וְעַתָּ֗ה יֵֽשֶׁב־נָ֤א עַבְדְּךָ֙ תַּ֣חַת הַנַּ֔עַר עֶ֖בֶד לַֽאדֹנִ֑י
t: וּכְעַן יֵתֶב כְּעַן עַבְדָךְ תְּחוֹת עוּלֵימָא עַבְדָא לְרִבּוֹנִי
e: And now, let your servant [now] remain as a slave to my master instead of the lad.
Let the lad go up with his brothers.
For how shall I go up to my father
when the lad is not with me;
lest I see the evil
that would befall my father.

h: וְלֹֽא־יָכֹ֨ל יוֹסֵ֜ף לְהִתְאַפֵּ֗ק לְכֹ֤ל הַנִּצָּבִים֙ עָלָ֔יו
t: וְלָא יְכִיל יוֹסֵף לְאִתְחַסָּנָא לְכֹל דְּקָיְמִין עִלָּו‍ֹהִי
e: Yoseif could not contain his emotions in the presence of all who stood before him,
and he cried out Let everyone leave my presence.
No man remained with him,
when Yoseif made himself known to his brothers.
He wept aloud,
and the Egyptians heard about it,
and the [people of the] house of Pharaoh [also] heard.

t: וְלָא יָכִילוּ אֲחוֹהִי לַאֲתָבָא יָתֵיהּ פִּתְגָּם
e: Yoseif said to his brothers, I am Yoseif,
is my father still alive?
His brothers could not answer [a word to] him
for they were shocked at his presence.

h: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹסֵ֧ף אֶל־אֶחָ֛יו גְּשׁוּ־נָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וַיִּגָּ֑שׁוּ
t: וַאֲמַר יוֹסֵף לַאֲחוֹהִי קְרִיבוּ כְעַן לְוָתִי וּקְרִיבוּ
e: [Then] Yoseif said to his brothers, Please [Now] come close to me. They came close [to him]
and he said, I am Yoseif your brother,
whom you sold into Egypt.

t: וּכְעַן לָא תִתְּנְסוּן וְלָא יִתְקָף בְּעֵינֵיכוֹן
e: Now do not worry, and do not be angry with yourselves
that you sold me here;
for it was to preserve life
that Elohim sent me [here] before you.

t: אֲרֵי דְנַן תַּרְתֵּין שְׁנִין כַּפְנָא בְּגוֹ אַרְעָא
e: For it is [now] two years that there has been famine in the land;
and for another five years
there will be no plowing [sowing] or harvest.
Elohim sent me [here] before you
to insure your survival in the land,
and to keep you alive
for a great deliverance.

t: וּכְעַן לָא אַתּוּן שְׁלַחְתּוּן יָתִי הָכָא
וְשַׁוְּיַנִי לְאַבָּא לְפַרְעֹה וּלְרִבּוֹן לְכָל אֱנַשׁ בֵּיתֵיהּ
e: Now [then] it was not you that sent me here,
but [it was from before] Elohim;
and He has made me as a father to Pharaoh, and master of all [the people of] his house,
and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

h: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֣ם אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ בִּנְךָ֣ יוֹסֵ֔ף
t: וְתֵימְרוּן לֵיהּ כִּדְנַן אֲמַר בְּרָךְ יוֹסֵף
e: Hurry, go up to my father
and tell him: this is what your son, Yoseif, says,
Elohim has made me master of all Egypt.
Come down to me, do not delay.

t: וְתֵתֵיב בְּאַרְעָא דְגשֶׁן וּתְהֵי קָרִיב לִי
e: You will dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be close to me —
you, your children, your grandchildren,
your sheep, your cattle and all that you own.

t: דִּלְמָא תִתְמַסְכַּן אַתְּ וֶאֱנַשׁ בֵּיתָךְ וְכָל דִּי לָךְ:
e: I will provide for you there,
since there will be another five years of famine;
lest you become impoverished together with [the people of] your household and all that is yours.
Behold, your eyes see it
along with my brother Binyomin’s eyes,
that I speak to you with my own mouth [in your language].

t: וּתְחַוּוּן לְאַבָּא יָת כָּל יְקָרִי בְּמִצְרַיִם
e: Tell my father of all my honor in Egypt,
and all that you saw.
Hurry and bring my father down here.

t: וּנְפַל עַל צַוְּארֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲחוּהִי וּבְכָא
e: He [then] fell upon his brother Binyomin’s neck and wept,
and Binyomin wept upon his neck.
He kissed all his brothers and wept upon [their necks].
After that
his brothers spoke with him.
The news was heard in Pharaoh’s house
that Yoseif’s brothers had come.
This was good [news] in the eyes of Pharaoh
and in the eyes of his servants.
Pharaoh said to Yoseif,
Tell your brothers to do this:
load up your beasts,
and go and enter [bring to] the land of Canaan.

t: וּדְבָרוּ יָת אֲבוּכוֹן וְיָת אֱנַשׁ בָּתֵּיכוֹן וְעוּלוּ לְוָתִי
וְאֶתֵּן לְכוֹן יָת טוּב אַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם
e: Bring your father and [the people of] your households and come to me;
and I will give you the best of the land of Egypt.
You will eat of the fat of the land.

h: קְחוּ־לָכֶם֩ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם עֲגָל֗וֹת לְטַפְּכֶם֙ וְלִנְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם
t: סִיבוּ לְכוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם עֶגְלָן לְטַפְלֵיכוֹן וְלִנְשֵׁיכוֹן
e: Now you are commanded [to order (your) brothers to] do the following:
Take wagons from the land of Egypt for your little ones and for your wives.
Bring your father and come.

t: אֲרֵי טַב כָּל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם דִּלְכוֹן הוּא:
e: Do not be concerned with your belongings,
for the best of Egypt is yours,

h: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֥ם יוֹסֵ֛ף עֲגָל֖וֹת עַל־פִּ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה
t: וִיהַב לְהוֹן יוֹסֵף עֶגְלָן עַל מֵימַר פַּרְעֹה
e: The sons of Yisrael did so.
Yoseif gave them wagons by order of Pharaoh,
and he gave them provisions for the journey.
To each of them, he gave a change of clothing.
To Binyomin he gave three hundred [selaim of] silver pieces
and five changes of clothing.

h: וְעֶ֣שֶׂר אֲתֹנֹ֡ת נֹֽ֠שְׂאֹת בָּ֣ר וָלֶ֧חֶם וּמָז֛וֹן לְאָבִ֖יו לַדָּֽרֶךְ׃
t: וַעֲסַר אַתְנָן טְעִינָן עִיבוּר וּלְחֵם וּזְוָדִין לַאֲבוּהִי לְאָרְחָא:
e: To his father he sent the following: Ten male donkeys
loaded with the best of Egypt,
and ten female donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and food [provisions] for his father for the journey.
He sent his brothers off and they went.
He said to them,
Do not be troubled [argue] along the way.
They went up from Egypt,
and they came to the land of Canaan,
to their father Yaakov.

h: וַיַּגִּ֨דוּ ל֜וֹ לֵאמֹ֗ר ע֚וֹד יוֹסֵ֣ף חַ֔י
t: וְחַוִּיאוּ לֵיהּ לְמֵימַר עוֹד כְּעַן יוֹסֵף קַיָּם
וַאֲרֵי הוּא שַׁלִּיט בְּכָל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם
e: They told him saying, Yoseif is still alive,
and he is ruler of all the land of Egypt.
His [Yaakov’s] heart stood still [The words created uncertainty in his heart],
for he could not believe them.

h: וַיְדַבְּר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו אֵ֣ת כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם
t: וּמַלִּילוּ עִמֵּיהּ יָת כָּל פִּתְגָּמֵי יוֹסֵף דִּי מַלִּיל עִמְּהוֹן
e: They told him all the words of Yoseif which he had spoken to them,
and he saw the wagons
that Yoseif had sent to carry him.
[Then] the spirit of [prophecy rested upon] their father Yaakov was revived.

t: סַגִּי לִי חֶדְוָא עַד כְּעַן יוֹסֵף בְּרִי קַיָּם
e: Yisrael said,
It is too much [There is great joy for me]! My son Yoseif still lives.
I will go and see him before I die.
Yisrael journeyed with all that he possessed,
and he came to Beer Sheva.
He offered sacrifices [there]
to the God of his father Yitzchok.
Elohim said to Yisrael in a night vision,
and He said, Yaakov, Yaakov.
And he said, Here I am.
He said I am the Almighty, God of your father.
Do not be afraid to do down to Egypt,
for there I will make you into a great nation.
I will go down with you to Egypt,
and I will also surely bring you up again.
Yoseif shall place his hand upon your eyes.

h: וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־יַעֲקֹ֣ב אֲבִיהֶ֗ם וְאֶת־טַפָּם֙ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם
t: וּנְטָלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יָת יַעֲקֹב אֲבוּהוֹן וְיָת טַפְלְהוֹן וְיָת נְשֵׁיהוֹן
בַּעֲגַלְתָּא דִּי שְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה לְמִטַּל יָתֵיהּ:
e: Yaakov rose up from Beer Sheva.
The sons of Yisrael transported their father Yaakov, their children, their wives
in the wagons that Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

h: וַיִּקְח֣וּ אֶת־מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם וְאֶת־רְכוּשָׁם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָֽכְשׁוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן
t: וּדְבָרוּ יָת גֵּיתֵיהוֹן וְיָת קִנְיָנְהוֹן דִּי קְנוֹ בְּאַרְעָא דִכְנַעַן
e: They took their livestock and their possessions that they had acquired in the land of Canaan,
and they came to Egypt;
Yaakov and all his descendants with him.
His sons and grandsons were with him.
His daughters and his granddaughters, and all his descendants
he brought with him to Egypt.

h: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שְׁמ֧וֹת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הַבָּאִ֥ים מִצְרַ֖יְמָה יַעֲקֹ֣ב וּבָנָ֑יו
t: וְאִלֵּין שְׁמָהַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּעַלּוּ לְמִצְרַיִם יַעֲקֹב וּבְנוֹהִי
e: These are the names of the sons of Yisrael who were coming to Egypt, Yaakov and his sons.
The firstborn of Yaakov was Reuvein.
The sons of Reuvein [were]:
Chanoch, Phallu, Chetzron and Carmi.

h: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן יְמוּאֵ֧ל וְיָמִ֛ין וְאֹ֖הַד וְיָכִ֣ין וְצֹ֑חַר
t: וּבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן יְמוּאֵל וְיָמִין וְאֹהַד וְיָכִין וְצֹחַר
e: The sons, of Shimon [were]: Yemueil, Yamin, Ohad, Yachin, Tzochar and Shaul,
the son of the Canaanite woman.
The sons of Leivi [were]
Gershon, Kehas and Merari.

h: וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֧ר וְאוֹנָ֛ן וְשֵׁלָ֖ה וָפֶ֣רֶץ וָזָ֑רַח
t: וּבְנֵי יְהוּדָה עֵר וְאוֹנָן וְשֵׁלָה וָפֶרֶץ וָזָרַח
e: The sons of Yehudah [were]: Eir, Onan, Sheiloh, Peretz and Zorach.
Eir and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
The sons of Peretz were Chetzron and Chamul.
The sons of Yissachar [were]:
Tolah, Phuvah, Yov and Shimron.
The sons of Zevulun [were]:
Sered, Eilon and Yachle’eil.

h: אֵ֣לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י לֵאָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָֽלְדָ֤ה לְיַעֲקֹב֙ בְּפַדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֔ם
t: אִלֵּין בְּנֵי לֵאָה דִּיְלִידַת לְיַעֲקֹב בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם
כָּל נֶפֶשׁ בְּנוֹהִי וּבְנָתֵיהּ תְּלָתִין וּתְלָת:
e: These are the sons of Leah that she bore to Yaakov in Padan Aram,
along with his daughter Deenah.
All the souls of his sons and daughters were thirty-three.
The sons of Gad [were]:
Tzifyon, Chagi, Shuni, Etzbon,
Eiri, Arodi, and Areili.

h: וּבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְיִשְׁוָ֛ה וְיִשְׁוִ֥י וּבְרִיעָ֖ה וְשֶׂ֣רַח אֲחֹתָ֑ם
t: וּבְנֵי אָשֵׁר יִמְנָה וְיִשְׁוָה וְיִשְׁוִי וּבְרִיעָה וְשֶׂרַח אֲחַתְהוֹן
e: The sons of Asher [were]: Yimnah, Yishvah, Yishvi, and Beriah, and their sister, Serach.
The sons of Beriah [were]:
Chever and Malki’eil.
These are the sons of Zilpah,
whom Lavan gave to his daughter, Leah.
She bore these to Yaakov,
sixteen souls.
The sons of Rochel, Yaakov’s wife [were]:
Yoseif and Binyomin.
In the land of Egypt, [sons] were born to Yoseif,
which were born to him by Osnas,
daughter of Poti Phera, priest [chief] of On;
[they were] Menasheh and Ephraim.
The sons of Binyomin [were]: Bela, Becher, Ashbeil,
Geiroh, Naamon, Eichi, Rosh,
Muppim, Chuppim and Ard.
These are the sons of Rochel
that she bore to Yaakov.
All the souls were fourteen.
The sons of Don [were] Chushim.
The sons of Naftali were:
Yachtze’eil, Guni, Yeitzer and Shileim.

t: וִילִידַת יָת אִלֵּין לְיַעֲקֹב כָּל נַפְשָׁא שִׁבְעָא:
e: These are the sons of Bilhah
whom Lavan gave to his daughter Rochel.
She bore these to Yaakov, seven souls in all.

h: כָּל־הַ֠נֶּפֶשׁ הַבָּאָ֨ה לְיַעֲקֹ֤ב מִצְרַ֙יְמָה֙ יֹצְאֵ֣י יְרֵכ֔וֹ
t: כָּל נַפְשָׁא דְּעַלָּא לְיַעֲקֹב לְמִצְרַיִם נָפְקֵי יַרְכֵּיהּ
e: All the souls coming with Yaakov to Egypt, who came out of his loins,
not counting the wives of Yaakov’s sons,
all the souls totaled sixty-six.

h: וּבְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֛ף אֲשֶׁר־יֻלַּד־ל֥וֹ בְמִצְרַ֖יִם נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׁנָ֑יִם
t: וּבְנֵי יוֹסֵף דִּי אִתְיְלִידוּ לֵיהּ בְּמִצְרַיִם נַפְשָׁתָא תְרֵין
כָּל נַפְשָׁתָא לְבֵית יַעֲקֹב דְּעַלּוּ לְמִצְרַיִם שִׁבְעִין:
e: The sons of Yoseif who were born to him in Egypt were [another] two souls.
All the souls of the house of Yaakov that came to Egypt were seventy.

t: וְיָת יְהוּדָה שְׁלַח קֳדָמוֹהִי לְוַת יוֹסֵף
e: He [Yaakov] sent Yehudah ahead of him to Yoseif,
so that he might direct him to [clear a place before him in] Goshen.
They then came to the land of Goshen.
Yoseif harnessed his chariot,
and went up to greet his father, Yisrael in Goshen.
[When] he appeared before him, he fell on his neck,
and wept on his neck for a long time.

t: וַאֲמַר יִשְׂרָאֵל לְיוֹסֵף אִלּוּ אֲנָא מָיִת זִמְנָא הָדָא מְנַחֵם אֲנָא
e: Yisrael said to Yoseif, Now I can [If I were to] die [now I will have been consoled];
after I have seen your face
that you are alive.

h: אַחַ֧י וּבֵית־אָבִ֛י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־כְּנַ֖עַן בָּ֥אוּ אֵלָֽי׃
t: אַחַי וּבֵית אַבָּא דִּי בְאַרְעָא דִכְנַעַן עַלּוּ לְוָתִי:
e: Yoseif said to his brothers and to his father’s household,
I will go up and tell Pharaoh.
I will say to him,
My brothers and my father’s household, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

t: וְעָנְהוֹן וְתוֹרְהוֹן וְכָל דִּי לְהוֹן אַיְתִיאוּ:
e: The men are shepherds,
for they are owners of livestock.
Their sheep, their cattle, and all their possessions, they have brought [with them.]
And when Pharaoh calls you,
and says, What is your occupation,

h: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִקְנֶ֜ה הָי֤וּ עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ מִנְּעוּרֵ֣ינוּ וְעַד־עַ֔תָּה
t: וְתֵימְרוּן גֻּבְרֵי מָרֵי גֵיתֵי הֲווֹ עַבְדָּיךְ מֵעוּלֵמָנָא וְעַד כְּעַן
e: You should say, Your servants have been livestock owners from our youth until now,
we and our fathers;
so that you will be able to settle in the land of Goshen,
since every shepherd is abhorrent to Egypt [the Egyptians make distant all shepherds].

h: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אָבִ֨י וְאַחַ֜י וְצֹאנָ֤ם וּבְקָרָם֙ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֔ם
t: וַאֲמַר אַבָּא וְאַחַי וְעָנְהוֹן וְתוֹרְהוֹן וְכָל דִּי לְהוֹן
e: Yoseif came and told Pharaoh,
and he said, My father, and my brothers, their sheep, their cattle, and all their possessions,
have come from the land of Canaan,
and they are now in the land of Goshen.
From among his brothers,
he took five men,
and he presented them to Pharaoh.
Pharaoh said to his brothers, What is your occupation?
They said to Pharaoh, Your servants are shepherds,
we and our fathers.

t: וַאֲמָרוּ לְוַת פַּרְעֹה לְאִתּוֹתָבָא בְאַרְעָא אֲתֵינָא
אֲרֵי לֵית רַעֲיָא לְעָנָא דִּי לְעַבְדָּיךְ
e: They said to Pharaoh, We have come to live in the land temporarily,
since there is no pasture for your servant’s flocks,
because the famine is severe in the land of Canaan.
Now then, please let your servants [now] settle in the land of Goshen.
Pharaoh said to Yoseif,
Your father and your brothers have come to you.

t: וְאִם יָדַעְתְּ וְאִית בְּהוֹן גֻּבְרִין דְּחֵילָא
וּתְמַנִּנּוּן רַבָּנֵי גֵיתֵי עַל דִּי לִי:
e: The land of Egypt is before you.
In the best of the land,
settle your father and your brothers.
Let them settle in the land of Goshen.
If you know of capable men among them,
appoint them livestock officers over my [herds.]
Yoseif [then] brought in Yaakov, his father,
and presented him to Pharaoh;
and Yaakov blessed Pharaoh.
Pharaoh said to Yaakov,
How many are the years of your life?

h: מְעַ֣ט וְרָעִ֗ים הָיוּ֙ יְמֵי֙ שְׁנֵ֣י חַיַּ֔י
וְלֹ֣א הִשִּׂ֗יגוּ אֶת־יְמֵי֙ שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י אֲבֹתַ֔י
t: זְעֵירִין וּבִישִׁין הֲווֹ יוֹמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיַּי
וְלָא אַדְבִּיקוּ יָת יוֹמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי אֲבָהָתַי
e: Yaakov said to Pharaoh,
The years of my temporary residence
are one hundred and thirty years.
Few and troublesome have been the days of my life.
I have not attained the years of my father’s lives,
in the days of their temporary residence.
Yaakov blessed Pharaoh,
and left Pharaoh’s presence.

t: וְאוֹתֵיב יוֹסֵף יָת אֲבוּהִי וְיָת אֲחוֹהִי
e: Yoseif settled his father and his brothers,
and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt,
in the best part of the land, in the land of Ramseis,
as Pharaoh had ordered.

t: וְזָן יוֹסֵף יָת אֲבוּהִי וְיָת אֲחוֹהִי
e: Yoseif provided his father, his brothers,
and all his father’s household
with bread according to [the needs of] the children.

t: וְאִשְׁתַּלְהֵי עַמָּא דְאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם וְעַמָּא דְאַרְעָא דִכְנַעַן
e: There was no bread in all the land,
for the famine was very severe.
The [the people of the] land of Egypt, and Canaan were worn out
because of the famine.

h: וַיְלַקֵּ֣ט יוֹסֵ֗ף אֶת־כָּל־הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ הַנִּמְצָ֤א בְאֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וּבְאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן
t: וְלַקִּיט יוֹסֵף יָת כָּל כַּסְפָּא דְּאִשְׁתְּכַח בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם וּבְאַרְעָא דִכְנַעַן
וְאַיְתֵי יוֹסֵף יָת כַּסְפָּא לְבֵית פַּרְעֹה:
e: Yoseif gathered up all the money that was to be found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan,
through the purchases [grain] they made.
Yoseif brought the money to the house of Pharaoh.

h: וַיִּתֹּ֣ם הַכֶּ֗סֶף מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֮ וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַעַן֒
וַיָּבֹאוּ֩ כָל־מִצְרַ֨יִם אֶל־יוֹסֵ֤ף לֵאמֹר֙ הָֽבָה־לָּ֣נוּ לֶ֔חֶם
t: וּשְׁלִים כַּסְפָּא מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם וּמֵאַרְעָא דִכְנַעַן
וַאֲתוֹ כָל מִצְרָאֵי לְוַת יוֹסֵף לְמֵימַר הַב לָנָא לַחְמָא
e: When the money was used up in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan,
all [the people of] Egypt came to Yoseif, saying, Give us bread;
why should we die in your presence,
[just] because there is no money?
Yoseif said, Bring your livestock,
and I will give you [food] [in exchange] for your livestock
if there is no more money.

h: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָהֶם֩ יוֹסֵ֨ף לֶ֜חֶם בַּסּוּסִ֗ים וּבְמִקְנֵ֥ה הַצֹּ֛אן וּבְמִקְנֵ֥ה הַבָּקָ֖ר וּבַחֲמֹרִ֑ים
t: וִיהַב לְהוֹן יוֹסֵף לַחְמָא בְּסוּסָוָתָא וּבְגֵיתֵי עָנָא וּבְגֵיתֵי תוֹרִין וּבַחֲמָרִין
e: They brought their livestock to Yoseif,
and Yoseif gave them bread [in exchange] for their horses, their flocks of sheep, their herds of cattle and their donkeys.
He tended [sustained] them with bread in exchange for all their livestock,
in that year.

h: וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ אֵלָ֜יו בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית וַיֹּ֤אמְרוּ לוֹ֙ לֹֽא־נְכַחֵ֣ד מֵֽאֲדֹנִ֔י
t: וַאֲתוֹ לְוָתֵיהּ בְּשַׁתָּא תִנְיֵתָא וַאֲמָרוּ לֵיהּ לָא נְכַסֵּי מִן רִבּוֹנִי
e: That year came to an end.
They came to him in the second year, and they said to him, We are holding nothing back from my master,
for the money is used up,
and the herds of cattle belong to my master.
There is nothing left before my master
except our bodies and our land.

h: לָ֧מָּה נָמ֣וּת לְעֵינֶ֗יךָ גַּם־אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ גַּ֣ם אַדְמָתֵ֔נוּ
t: לְמָה נְמוּת לְעֵינָיךְ אַף אֲנַחְנָא אַף אַרְעָתָנָא
וְהַב בַּר זַרְעָא וְנֵיחֵי וְלָא נְמוּת
e: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land?
Buy us and our land [in exchange] for bread.
We and our land will become slaves to Pharaoh.
Give us seed grain, let us live and not die,
and let the land not become desolate [uncultivated].

t: וּקְנָא יוֹסֵף יָת כָּל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם לְפַרְעֹה
e: Yoseif bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh,
for every Egyptian sold his field,
because the famine was severe upon them.
Thus the land became Pharaoh’s [property.]
He [Yoseif] then transferred the people to cities [from city to city],
from one end of the border of Egypt to the other.

h: כִּי֩ חֹ֨ק לַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים מֵאֵ֣ת פַּרְעֹ֗ה וְאָֽכְל֤וּ אֶת־חֻקָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן לָהֶם֙ פַּרְעֹ֔ה
t: אֲרֵי חֳלָקָא לְכֻמָּרַיָּא מִלְּוַת פַּרְעֹה וְאָכְלִין יָת חֳלָקְהוֹן דִּיהַב לְהוֹן פַּרְעֹה
עַל כֵּן לָא זַבִּינוּ יָת אַרְעֲהוֹן:
e: But the land of the priests he did not buy,
because the priests had an allotment from Pharaoh. They ate the allotment that Pharaoh gave them,
and therefore they did not sell their land.

h: הֵן֩ קָנִ֨יתִי אֶתְכֶ֥ם הַיּ֛וֹם וְאֶת־אַדְמַתְכֶ֖ם לְפַרְעֹ֑ה
t: הָא זְבֵנִית יָתְכוֹן יוֹמָא דֵין וְיָת אַרְעֲכוֹן לְפַרְעֹה
e: Yoseif said to the people,
Behold, I have today purchased you and your lands for Pharaoh.
Here is seed,
plant [it in] the soil.

h: וְאַרְבַּ֣ע הַיָּדֹ֡ת יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶם֩ לְזֶ֨רַע הַשָּׂדֶ֧ה וּֽלְאָכְלְכֶ֛ם וְלַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּבָתֵּיכֶ֖ם וְלֶאֱכֹ֥ל לְטַפְּכֶֽם׃
t: וְאַרְבַּע חֳלָקִין יְהֵא לְכוֹן לְבַר זְרַע חַקְלָא וּלְמֵיכַלְכוֹן וְלֶאֱנַשׁ בְּבָתֵּיכוֹן וּלְמֵיכַל לְטַפְלְכוֹן:
e: When it produces [the produce is gathered]
you must give a fifth to Pharaoh.
Four parts shall be yours for seed for your fields and for your food, and for those [the people] of your households, and for food for your little ones.
They said, You have saved our lives.
May we find favor in the eyes of my master,
and we will be slaves to Pharaoh.

h: וַיָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֣הּ יוֹסֵ֡ף לְחֹק֩ עַד־הַיּ֨וֹם הַזֶּ֜ה עַל־אַדְמַ֥ת מִצְרַ֛יִם לְפַרְעֹ֖ה לַחֹ֑מֶשׁ
t: וְשַׁוִּי יָתַהּ יוֹסֵף לִגְזֵרָא עַד יוֹמָא הָדֵין עַל אַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם דִּיהוֹן יָהֲבִין חַד מִן חַמְשָׁא לְפַרְעֹה
e: Yoseif enacted a statute over the land of Egypt to this day, that a fifth belongs [they should give a fifth] to Pharaoh.
Except the land of the priests alone,
did not belong to Pharaoh.

h: וַיֵּ֧שֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֑שֶׁן
t: וִיתֵיב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם בְּאַרְעָא דְגשֶׁן
e: Yisrael lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen.
They acquired property there.
They were fruitful and [their population] increased greatly.
